target.summary: Iterating over VIDEO_PROCESSOR_MAPPING instead of VIDEO_PROCESSOR_MAPPING_NAMES resolves all entries in the lazy mapping. This causes all registered video processor modules to be eagerly imported when looking up a video processor, defeating lazy loading.
notes: faulty statement iterating over VIDEO_PROCESSOR_MAPPING instead of VIDEO_PROCESSOR_MAPPING_NAMES in video_processor_class_from_name
